commit.message:
Preserve exact checkpoint JSON in browser imports

Reuse the existing request transport with a raw JSON envelope, preserving signed-i64 seed text and normal error behavior. Recover the three independently reviewed source files, add a new 15-case maintained transport gate, and preserve current main plus the original native-receiving uncertainty.

Refs #107. Native candidate-browser completion remains unknown; source PR requires current-head hosted gates and receiving.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+# Import an exported career checkpoint
+
+In the Career library, choose a checkpoint JSON file using the existing Import control. Leave the optional name blank to use the native simulator's generated name, or enter a new library name.
+
+Import preserves the complete snapshot JSON text, including signed 64-bit seeds that cannot be represented exactly by JavaScript numbers. The native simulator still checks the checkpoint's structure, compatibility and library name before storing it. Import does not overwrite an existing named checkpoint implicitly.
+
+Malformed JSON and JSON values other than objects are rejected before a request is sent. Native validation failures continue to appear through the existing library error display. After a successful import the library list refreshes; use the existing Resume action to continue the imported career.

@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+# Browser checkpoint import: recovered source and new focused qualification
+
+This packet publishes the exact three production files accepted in the [independent source review](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/uma-sim/blob/09c94cc504b6f51ef329cf765ca075e89e7beb72/docs/continuity/evidence/browser-checkpoint-import-independent-20261008-d98d06fb/README.md), composed onto current main `8d74413d7dbc3caf1745779c92d56b6eb7feea42`. It adds one newly authored maintained test and preserves the original evidence boundary. Source contribution: issue107, `chatgpt:d98d06fbfc35:production_execution`; recovery continuation: `production_recovery`.
+
+## Change and preservation
+
+The browser keeps the imported snapshot as its original JSON text. A small helper validates that it is one JSON object and safely encodes the optional name. An explicit serialized-body argument in the existing private request helper sends that envelope through the existing route, response parser and error handling. The library-store import hook calls this additive method; the existing object-import API remains available.
+
+Current main has the exact original client blob `bed38774d5dcd48af5b964d97472a76db92f78e7` and store blob `6cc39e49150ab6774cb78aac1b89676b704418f8` used by the independent review. The three published production postimages match that frozen review byte for byte. The package test command receives one appended argument, preserving every existing argument and all other package bytes. The current conditions, race results, skills, training inspection, setup and native work are retained.
+
+The current issue63 owner explicitly confirms that private `req` and response/error transport are outside its session fence in [comment6066934788](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/uma-sim/issues/63#issuecomment-6066934788). Its exact fetched statement is retained in `owner-scope.json`. This contribution leaves `withSession` and all run/session methods unchanged; the owner's forthcoming session composition remains separately owned. The earlier unacknowledged request and the unavailable author's secondary-403 follow-up are not relabelled as successful messages.
+
+## Actual new focused gate
+
+The newly authored `packages/uma-sim-ui/tests/checkpoint-json.test.mjs` passed **15/15 tests**, zero failures or skips, on Linux Node24.19.0 with TypeScript5.9.3. Seven decimal seed cases include both signed-i64 endpoints and positive/negative unsafe JavaScript integers. Other cases cover absent/escaped names, malformed and nonobject input with zero requests, the existing object import, ordinary GET/POST defaults, native error diagnostics, invalid response JSON and unchanged network failures with no retry.
+
+The compiler version matches the current repository lock. Its exact installed file was read and hashed before and after the run from an existing separate UI checkout; that checkout was not changed. The shared filesystem had no available unreserved bytes, so the exact maintained test ran in memory through `vm.SourceTextModule`. Only its two declared UTF-8 source reads were supplied by the exact recovered source strings. The test still used the actual locked-version TypeScript transpiler, standard `node:test`, production helper/client code and a private inert fetch receiver. No source/test assertions were adapted for the run.
+
+`gate-runner.cjs`, `gate-input.json` and `gate-execution.json` preserve the exact executed program, argument and normalized execution result including complete output and exit0. The original invocation used Node's `-e` mode, so the runner reads its JSON input from `process.argv[1]`. A future host must supply its own verified compiler location and retain that new execution separately. This run made no filesystem writes or real network requests and did not execute a native API, browser, simulation, service or installed application.
+
+## Original evidence that remains unavailable
+
+The original author reported a successful Mac npm/test/typecheck/build gate and seven owner-composition controls. Their raw author packet and original maintained-test bytes were held in the former execution context and were never published. They are not reconstructed here or counted as this packet's actual executed gates. A historical summary named a 22-file manifest prefix `8129b760`; this incomplete identifier is not used as a verification pin.
+
+The original Mac candidate-browser start and its single result read timed out. Completion of the actual exported-checkpoint import and native continuation remains **unknown**. That attempt has not been relaunched. Mac is offline in the current recovered inventory. Source review and this inert transport gate do not establish native checkpoint validity, restored RNG/state equality, successful candidate-browser receiving, an installed-package update or a production benefit.
+
+The existing independent packet at `09c94cc504b6f51ef329cf765ca075e89e7beb72` is complete and immutable: 15 files, manifest SHA256 `8deea32215b07a59898be0ce0532f87bfa6b6de22bbd3c24f4bef1f8eea9af8f`. It preserves the original lexical transport control and its actual exit0 receipt, source reconstruction, owner-composition comparison and the first failed comment-omission comparison. Those controls were not rerun during recovery.
+
+## Receiving and integration
+
+The source PR remains a draft until its current-head required hosted gates and native receiving boundary are resolved. A full current application typecheck/build is not claimed by the new focused gate. The existing repository workflows and scanner policy are unchanged. A fresh base/owner review, independent acceptance and expected-head normal merge remain required under `docs/agent-operations.md`.
+
+The manifest binds every contributed source, maintained-test, usage and evidence file except the manifest itself. Publication readback verifies the entire resulting Git tree and all unchanged incoming leaves and modes; its final commit/tree identity is recorded in the PR rather than embedded recursively in this packet.
